development01CounterEvidence.finding: Fresh repeats agree with each other at every captured Native output, submitted VideoFrame buffer/metadata, encoder configuration and decoded frame. Both differ from the historical original Native in 25/240 output frames; therefore they cannot establish the historical original encoding cause or certify its control equivalence.
development01CounterEvidence.audioAnalysisFinding: Both native-only runs retain the same 25 original Native mismatches. Analyzing the original audio before drawing does not change that mismatch. Differences coincide with the two Noto Serif JP fragments; recorded primary parameters and font-loading descriptors equal the historical trace. Actual font resources/raster environment are being compared; no encoder cause is established.

fontCounterEvidence.finding: Shared font-file bytes and the 12 isolated glyph samples are identical. These observations do not explain the 25 full-render Native mismatches. The affected Noto Serif JP draw calls originate in diag layout secondary strips, not the authoritative mainDraw lyric. Missing decorated glyph preloading alone also failed to reproduce the original.
